note: Archetypes of user controls (grid, tree, menu, toolbar, list). The designer decides first: a unit whose visual content is mainly a DataGridView / TreeView / MenuStrip / ToolStrip / ListView is that archetype. These name patterns apply only when the designer cannot decide (an empty or near-empty designer, or no data control with only a few inputs), e.g. a control that builds its grid, tree or menu in code. A unit with more than inputThreshold input controls is an edit form and keeps its designer. Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions tried against the class name and against the name without its Hungarian prefix, in order; first match wins. Data only: extend a copy per project (generic words only, no application names) and point --archetypes at it.
